title: 2007 HMMT February Team Round 1 Problem 2
statement: Solve for the positive integer(s) \(n\) such that \(\phi\left(n^{2}\right)=1000 \phi(n)\).

solutions.text: The unique solution is \(n=1000\). For, \(\phi(p n)=p \phi(n)\) for every prime \(p\) dividing \(n\), so that \(\phi\left(n^{2}\right)=n \phi(n)\) for all positive integers \(n\).
